newsitem.title: FRANCE: Club Med up after shareholder pact ends.
newsitem.headline: Club Med up after shareholder pact ends.

text.p: Shares in French resort company Club Mediterranee jumped on Monday on the Paris bourse on speculation fuelled by a decision on Friday by five major shareholders to end a six-year pact, brokers said.

"People are speculating about what might happen," said one broker. The decision by the five big shareholders, who owned a combined 29 percent, makes it easier for them to sell and for another bidder to come in.
At 1015 GMT Club Med shares were up 4.57 percent at 331.5 francs.
